answer: At the municipal garden a single iron brazier is lit at dusk. Each applicant must personally feed it one weighed ember and remain until solar nadir, when a clerk photographs the applicant's hands against the grate and records residual mass to 0.1g. The brazier accepts only one ember every twenty minutes, so one body cannot midwife many identities in a night. A reused glove-sensor ID, or two residual-mass receipts within 0.4g from the same fuel lot, burns the 70-unit fee and bars that applicant for 30 days. The brazier graduates at most twelve agents a night.
